subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw support for callback fields that are siblings of `action.value`?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the exact synthetic-message shape affects channel message semantics and compatibility for existing button commands.

options.title: Review the linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953 as the active implementation path and require compatibility review plus real Feishu proof there.

options.title: Define a typed envelope first
options.body: Pause the current PR and specify a stable Feishu callback payload envelope before accepting broader raw-field pass-through.

options.title: Limit support to action.value
options.body: Reject broader callback expansion for now and document that form/select/input card actions are unsupported.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953 as the active implementation path and require compatibility review plus real Feishu proof there.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent Feishu area owner in current main history and are the best available reviewer for plugin payload contract direction.
